colosseum.desc: Multiple pits, floor flippers, wall saws and two house robots.
colosseum.name: The Colosseum

foundry.desc: Floor flame jets and a channel of molten metal.
foundry.name: The Foundry

icefactory.desc: Slippery ice, a turntable and a ceiling press.
icefactory.name: The Ice Factory

scrapyard.desc: Loose objects to push and smash.
scrapyard.name: The Scrapyard

workshop.desc: Simple layout with floor spikes and one house robot.
workshop.name: The Workshop

campaign.starRules: ★ Win · ★★ Win within {par} s · ★★★ Win within {par} s taking less than {dmg}% damage
campaign.subtitle: Tournament ladder · {stars}/{max} stars
campaign.title: Campaign

credits.made: IRONCLASH ARENA – made with TypeScript, Phaser and lots of metallic love.
credits.original: All robots, arenas, names and characters are original and fictional.
credits.procedural: All graphics, music and sound are generated procedurally in code – no licensed assets.
credits.title: Credits

error.text: Sorry! The game hit an unexpected error. Reload – your progress is saved.
error.title: Something broke

garage.hint: Hover a part to compare before/after. Weight limit: {limit} kg. Parts sell for 60% of their price.
garage.overweight: Overweight! Remove or swap parts to get under the weight limit.
garage.previewLabel: 3D preview of {name}. Use the arrow keys to rotate.
garage.subtitle: Build, upgrade and paint your robot
garage.title: Garage

c04.intro: Welcome to the bronze final! Sir Grindalot has ruled this workshop for years – and his hammer has crushed more chassis than we can count. Stay away from his front!
c04.outro: What a fight! The bronze trophy is yours. Next stop: the Foundry, where the floor is literally on fire!

c08.intro: Molten Maw awaits in the crucible. Its jaws can hold a robot for seconds – and it knows exactly where the flames are.
c08.outro: The Silver League is conquered! Get your studs on – the Ice Factory is slicker than it looks.

c12.intro: Voltress adapts to everything you do. She has studied every fight you've fought. Surprise her!
c12.outro: Gold! Only the Colosseum remains – and there every hazard is live at once.

c13.intro: Welcome to the Colosseum! Old enemies have rebuilt stronger. Can you survive the gauntlet?

c15.intro: This is it. Iron Sovereign has never lost in this arena. The crowd holds its breath …
c15.outro: INCREDIBLE! We have a new champion! Your name will be welded into the Iron Throne forever!

hud.moveHint: Move – or you'll be counted out!

local.fairHint: Evens out budget differences with a small HP adjustment so expensive builds don't win automatically.
local.subtitle: Two players on one machine
local.title: Local 2-player

menu.footer: No tracking · Saved locally in your browser
menu.title: Main menu

online.createHint: Get a 6-character code and a link to share.

errors.closed: The other player left the room.
errors.network: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notFound: Room not found. Check the code.
errors.version: You are running different game versions. Both of you should reload.

online.hostStarts: The host starts the match when both are ready.
online.name: Player name
online.p2pNote: The connection is peer-to-peer. Behind strict firewalls a TURN server may be needed (see README).
online.subtitle: Private room with code – browser to browser (WebRTC)
online.title: Online

balanced.desc: Equal protection all around. Tiers: mild steel → aluminium → hardened steel → titanium → composite ceramic.
balanced.name: Even armour

frontHeavy.desc: A thick front plate that shrugs off head-on hits and pushes harder – but the rear is exposed.
frontHeavy.name: Heavy front, light rear

shuffler.desc: Walking legs: enormous grip and push, but slow and heavy.
shuffler.name: Shuffler

tracks.desc: Lots of grip and push, a bit slower.
tracks.name: Tracks

wheels.desc: Fast and nimble with moderate grip. Light.
wheels.name: Wheels

capacity.desc: Big battery for long fights and plenty of boost.
capacity.name: High capacity

regen.desc: Smaller battery that recharges quickly. Stronger overboost.
regen.name: Fast regeneration

magnetAnchor.desc: Clamps you to the floor: resists flips and adds push.
magnetAnchor.name: Magnet anchor

selfRight.desc: Flip yourself back quickly when upside down (hold special).
selfRight.name: Self-righting

sensor.desc: Shows the opponent's weapon cooldown and adds a little damage.
sensor.name: Sensor

shieldPulse.desc: Shockwave that pushes enemies away and halves damage briefly. Breaks grabs.
shieldPulse.name: Shield pulse

smokeScreen.desc: Dense smoke that confuses AI sensors.
smokeScreen.name: Smoke screen

crusher.desc: Grabs and holds the opponent, dealing damage over time – carry them into a hazard!
crusher.name: Crusher/claw

drum.desc: Vertical drum that throws opponents upward. Gyro effect slows turning.
drum.name: Drum spinner

flamethrower.desc: Sets the opponent on fire – damage over time.
flamethrower.name: Flamethrower

flipper.desc: Pneumatic flipper that launches opponents and can flip them over. Energy hungry, long cooldown. Can self-right.
flipper.name: Flipper

hSpinner.desc: Hold the weapon key to build RPM – damage scales with RPM. Recoil hits both robots.
hSpinner.name: Horizontal spinner

hammer.desc: Overhead strike with high damage to top armour. Can self-right.
hammer.name: Hammer/axe

magnet.desc: Pulls the opponent towards you and slows their drive.
magnet.name: Electromagnet

saw.desc: Continuous damage on contact. Short reach.
saw.name: Saw

wedge.desc: No active damage, but superior pushing and a chance to get under the opponent. The weapon key triggers a ramming dash.
wedge.name: Wedge/ram

pause.onlineNote: Online matches can't be paused – the fight continues in the background.
pause.title: Paused

practice.info: You drive {name}. The dummy stands still and takes everything.
practice.subtitle: Infinite-HP dummy with visible damage numbers
practice.title: Practice arena

results.repairNeeded: Repairs cost ⛁ {cost} (in the garage or campaign map).
results.title: Result

save.corruptText: We couldn't read your save file. You can start over with a fresh save.

settings.accessHint: All menus work with the keyboard (Tab, arrows, Enter, Esc). Hazards are shown with both colour and pattern.
settings.gamepadHint: Gamepad: left stick/D-pad drives, A/RB = weapon, B/LB = special, X = boost, Start = pause. Gamepads are assigned automatically.
settings.importFailed: The file is not a valid save.
settings.repairHint: Damage carries over between campaign fights and must be repaired with credits. The Mechanic difficulty always enables this.
settings.resetConfirm: This deletes all credits, parts and campaign progress. Settings are kept.
settings.title: Settings

errors.equipped: The part is equipped on a robot – swap it out first.
errors.locked: This part is not unlocked yet.
errors.overweight: That would make the robot overweight.
errors.slots: At most two support modules at once.

shop.sellConfirm: Sell {name} for ⛁ {value}? All levels are lost.

splash.tagline: Build your combat robot, upgrade it in the garage and smash rivals in trap-filled arenas.
splash.title: Title screen

boost.text: Hold {boost} while driving to boost. It uses energy – watch the blue bar.
boost.title: Boost

drive.text: Use {up} and {down} to drive forwards and backwards.
drive.title: Drive

ram.text: Ram Rusty Rex! Hits to the sides and rear deal more damage than to the front.
ram.title: Attack

rules.text: Destroy your opponent, push it into the pit once it opens, or win on judges' points. Stay still for 10 seconds and you're counted out – and keep out of the yellow corner zones (CPZ)!
rules.title: How to win

turn.text: Turn with {left} and {right}. The robot turns on the spot like a tank.
turn.title: Turn

weapon.text: Press {weapon} to use your weapon. The wedge performs a powerful ramming dash.
weapon.title: Weapon
